title: Inspect battery cycle count
notes: Read Cycle Count in the Battery Information section. This prints the power report, not just a number.
A Mac without a battery may have no battery section.

title: Inspect Spotlight metadata for a file
notes: Shows Spotlight attributes, not every possible filesystem or application-specific attribute.
Unindexed files or unavailable attributes may produce missing or null values.

title: Inspect assertions preventing sleep
notes: Shows current power assertions and their owners. It is a snapshot, not a complete diagnosis of every sleep problem.
